Title for Steam Workshop subscription result dialogs.

Text: 訂閱時與Steam伺服器通訊失敗: {0} ({1})

Steam confirmation prompt. {0} is the mod name.

Text: Steam拒絕了 {0} 的訂閱請求。錯誤代碼: {1}
Comment: Steam subscribe rejection. {0} is the mod name. {1} is the Steam error code.

Text: 成功訂閱: {0}。Steam客戶端將很快開始下載檔案。您必須重新啟動遊戲才能使變更生效。
Comment: Steam subscribe success message. {0} is the mod name.
Fallback mod name used when a Steam callback cannot be matched to a tracked mod.

Text: 取消訂閱時與Steam伺服器通訊失敗: {0} ({1})
Comment: Steam unsubscribe error. {0} is the mod name. {1} is the Steam Workshop item ID.
Steam confirmation prompt. {0} is the mod name.

Text: Steam拒絕了 {0} 的取消訂閱請求。錯誤代碼: {1}

Text: 成功取消訂閱: {0}。檔案將在遊戲重新啟動時完全清除。
